courses.title: Machine Learning Specialization
courses.description_text: Build machine learning models using supervised and unsupervised techniques with practical labs.
courses.outcomes_text: Apply regression and classification algorithms. Evaluate model performance. Build neural networks for core predictive tasks.
courses.weekly_topics_text: Week 1: Supervised learning. Week 2: Regression and classification. Week 3: Neural networks basics. Week 4: Unsupervised learning.

courses.title: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
courses.description_text: Learn foundational cybersecurity concepts, threat analysis, and incident response workflows.
courses.outcomes_text: Identify common threats and vulnerabilities. Use SIEM workflows and security logs. Communicate risk and remediation steps.
courses.weekly_topics_text: Week 1: Security fundamentals. Week 2: Threat landscape. Week 3: Incident response. Week 4: Security operations.

courses.title: Business Analytics Specialization
courses.description_text: Use data-driven methods for customer analytics, operations, accounting, and people analytics.
courses.outcomes_text: Interpret data for managerial decisions. Apply predictive analytics and segmentation methods. Build dashboard-oriented decision support.
courses.weekly_topics_text: Week 1: Data and decision framing. Week 2: Forecasting and classification. Week 3: Customer and operations analytics. Week 4: Managerial communication.
